text:
Maya R: Heads up — after we pushed q4b-int8 to staged yesterday, we've started getting customer reports of repeated phrases and weird insertions on long summaries. Also seeing tail latency regressions for >8k contexts. Anyone already on this?
Samir P: saw the alerts. possible quantization mismatch or kernel scheduling issue. quick triage: compare fp16 vs int8 inference traces and run the quantized regression suite. :eyes:
Devon: I pulled evals run from last night — summarization_hallucination jumped ~8% absolute on our long-doc set. math_problems perplexity ~+0.7. small sample attached below.
Devon: example bad output (gold vs q4b-int8):
```
GOLD: The committee decided to postpone the vote to June.
Q4B-INT8: The committee decided to postpone the vote to June. June is when the event will be held, organizers said.
```
Ajay K: not great. can we reproduce locally with the same kernel selection? run: 
```bash
./bin/compare_kernels --model q4b --profiles fp16 int8 --report /tmp/q4b-quant-report.json
```
Samir P: +1. also check KV cache invalidation — I've seen int8 kernels sometimes mishandle rotary/pos-emb at long seq lengths.
Helen C: infra metrics show GPU memory spike correlated with the requests. from ded-nyc-1 logs at 03:12:22 UTC:
```
PID 12345 python  95% GPU  24.1 GiB used (spike at token ~7200)
CUDA kernel timeouts: 0
Context switch rate up 2.1x
```
infra-bot: alert: tail_latency_p95(q4b-int8) on dedicated-pool-ded-nyc-1 breached 2.0s threshold (current 2.7s) — linked run: https://redwood.internal/runs/98321
evals-bot: nightly-regressions/q4b-int8: summarization_hallucination +8.6%, math_perplexity +0.9%, embedding-similarity -0.03 (small). Full report: https://evals.redwood/internal/98321
Maya R: thanks. let's assemble a quick intake/prioritization: 1) Reproduce locally with provided inputs 2) Run fp16 vs int8 kernel diff 3) Run hallucination-focused evals & sample inspection 4) Check KV cache and rotary handling at >8k 5) Check batching behavior & memory pressure 6) If production-impacting, fallback route to fp16 variant for canary and critical customers.
Ajay K: I'll take kernel diffs and local reproduce. Devon, can you produce 20 failing examples (short/long) and add to the evals set?
Devon: on it — will push to evals/regressions/q4b_long_summaries by EOD.
Helen C: ops note — ded-nyc-1 has a higher avg request size since yesterday. ops could throttle burst batching for q4b-int8 to see if memory-normalizes.
ops: opening ticket RED-ML-4125 and tagging eng-ml, eng-runtime, infra. cc <@Maya R> link: https://jira.redwood/RED-4125
Samir P: if we need a fast mitigation: change routing policy to prefer q4b-fp16 for routes with context >6k. that's a small config change in routing rules.
Maya R: agree — set as hot action item if reproduction confirms quality drop. Ajay, once you have kernel diff, share the report and any suspicious op timings.
Ajay K: will run `--trace-op-times` and post results. example flag: `--trace-op-times --max-tokens 10000`
Devon: sample excerpt from failed case (embedding similarity drop):
```
Input: long news article (8.2k tokens)
FP16 embedding cos: 0.912
INT8 embedding cos: 0.841
```
Maya R: yikes. that embedding drop alone could explain downstream rerank issues. prioritize embedding/regression+hallucination.
infra-bot: note — scheduled background compaction running on nodes 3 and 4 at 03:30 UTC may have affected memory.
Samir P: after Ajay's diff, if we see kernel-level numerical drift, let's try re-quantize with per-channel symmetric vs per-tensor and compare. avoid full retrain.
Ajay K: timeline: local reproduce + kernel diff by 12:00 PT, upload report. if confirmed, Dev/Infra to prepare routing rollback to fp16 canary.
Maya R: okay — tagging priority P0 for customer-impacting regressions. :fire: keep this thread for updates. please drop short status pings here (1-2 lines).
Devon: 11:09 — pushed 20 failing examples and updated evals job.
Ajay K: 11:35 — initial kernel diff uploaded: /tmp/q4b-quant-report.json (summary: several ops show 0.8–1.5% numeric deviation at >6k tokens; attention softmax kernel shows larger drift).
Maya R: good progress. ops, please stand by to flip routing if needed.
ops: standing by. will hold change window at 12:30 PT.
Maya R: thanks all — we'll reconvene in 45m if rollback is required.
